patch.value: Make the screening packet compact: decisions and pointers well below raw candidate text

Follow-up after PR #1; no compact-packet implementation belongs to this PR. The frozen public proof currently expands the five-issue frame from 1865 raw estimated tokens to 4248 across all packet pages (7459 versus 16992 bytes). The 80-item frame falls from 103661 to 97953 estimated tokens, only about 5 percent savings (414644 versus 391811 bytes). The 98.97 percent cold-resume saving uses a different complete-frame reread baseline and does not establish compact full-corpus transport. Design decisions-and-pointers packets with reusable protocol/source identities and explicit access to the complete audit witnesses.

Measure final UTF-8 bytes and ceil(bytes/4) for JSON and TOON, including every envelope, receipt, shared protocol and continuation page; report full-stream and cold-resume baselines separately.; On each existing frozen public frame, compact full-stream delivery costs at most 50 percent of raw candidate bytes, including the five-issue frame; preserve exact measured before/after numbers and do not satisfy this by changing candidates or shortening source baselines.; Preserve every candidate decision, source/version pointer, criterion reason and unresolved/conflict state, alias and population denominator, conservation equation and completeness qualification; retain a documented route to all original audit vectors.; Version and document compatibility explicitly; keep native expected-revision mutations, replay, privacy, stale-cursor refusal, JSON/TOON equivalence, 1600-token defaults and 32 KiB page ceilings.; Add positive and negative regressions and a behavioral revert proof, rerun the frozen corpus and ten resume answers with identical decisions and reasons, and pass the unchanged full npm/Bun release gates.
